correctness.rationale: For each nontrivial binary cut S with k members and r cyclic runs, homogeneous two-tap averaging has exactly 2 min(theta,1-theta) r^2 Gini deficit. Sitewise perturbations change only 2r boundary outputs. Convex maximization over the box reduces to signs, with perturbation contribution <=2 epsilon[r^2+(2k-n)d-d^2] <=2 epsilon r^2(n-2); the r=1 case and r>=2 use |2k-n|<=n-2r. Layer cake extends the cut estimate to arbitrary real f with the osc(f) factor. A singleton cut and opposite perturbations at two adjacent output rows make the defect exactly 2[mu-(n-2)epsilon], turning negative just above mu/(n-2). Direct rational exhaustive checks independently verified all cuts and parameter-cube vertices for n=4,5,6 and theta=1/4,1/2,3/4 at critical radius; these are finite validations of an algebraic all-n proof.
